title: A Prospective Study of a New Immunological Fecal Occult Blood Test
brief_summary: The purpose of the investigators study is to evaluate the diagnostic ability of a new immunological fecal occult blood test in Cuban patients undergoing colonoscopy .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients (men or women) that are \>18 years of age referred to colonoscopy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Visible rectal bleeding
* Known diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease
* Hematuria
* Menstruation at the time of obtaining a stool specimen
* Patients taking medication such as non steroids anti inflammatory drugs and anticoagulants
study_population: Residents of Havana City admitted at the investigation center.
